newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Nov 19 - Santa Fe - Two vessels berthed loading wheat, no vessels in roads/due. Max Recommended draft 30 ft 6 ins at access channel. Diamante - One vessel berthed loading wheat, no vessels in roads/due .Max recommended draft 30 ft. 6 ins at passage km 520. San Lorenzo - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbm, 1 sbo, 1 sbmp. 2 In roads, 27 due at 9 terminals in coming week. Max Recommended draft 34 ft. 8 ins. Forecast indicates this will keep rising for the next week. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Pasa berth draft 25 ft. 2 ins Fw. Nidera berth draft 34 ft 8 Ins Fw.

Rosario - Six vessels berthed of which 3 awaiting orders, 1 loading sbmp, 1 sbo, 1 sugar, 1 in roads, 13 due in week. Max Recommended draft 34 ft. 8 ins. Forecast indicates this will keep rising for the next week. Recommended draft guided by EM channel. Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed/in roads, 2 due Max draft 34 ft. 8 ins, forecast indicates this will keep rising for next week. Recommended draft guided by EM channel. Elevator berths max draft 22 ft fw. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 1 discharging iron ore. 1 in roads, none due in next week Max. Recommended draft 34 ft 8 ins. Forecast indicates will keep rising for next week. Guided by EM channel. San Pedro - No vessels berthed/due/in roads. Guided by EM channel. Draft for EM channel (high tide) 31 ft 6 Ins.

Buenos Aires - 20 In port, 32 due in next week. Max Recommended draft 31 ft. 6 Ins Fw. high tide NAABSA (guided by entrance channel) Buenos Aires dock Sud max draft 29 ft Fw. High tide NAABSA. Necochea - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 1 fish, no vessels in roads, 6 due in next week. Max draft 40 ft. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed, loading, 1 sun pellets, 2 crude, 1 lpg, 1 fish. No vessels in roads, 10 due in week, draft depending on individual berth.

BRAZIL, Nov 19 - Vitoria - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 container/general cargo discharger, 1 malt discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 rice discharger, 1 paper/coils/cellulose loader, 1 fruit discharger, 1 granite loader, 1 vehicle discharger. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders, 1 petroleum discharger. Praia Mole - 3 Steel plate loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - No vessels, 16 waiting in roads. Santos - 36 Vessels berthed, 7 full containers, 1 general cargo, 1 cement discharger, 11 sugar loaders. 7 Fertiliser dischargers, 1 juice loader, 1 pellets loader, 1 salt discharger, 1 cotton discharger, 1 chemical products discharger, 1 jute discharger, 1 coal discharger, 1 vehicle loader, 1 lpg discharger. 18 Waiting in roads, 72 due over next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 2 Iron ore dischargers, 1 sand discharger, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultra-fertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Itajai - Three berthed of which 1 reefer, 1 full container, 1 general cargo. 2 Waiting in roads, 15 due over next 7 days. Rio Grande - 11 Berthed of which 5 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 containers, 1 wood-chip loader, 1 acid discharger, 2 soy loaders. 1 Waiting in roads, 9 due over next 10 days. Paranagua - 13 Berthed of which 3 pellets loaders, 1 sugar loader, 1 reefer loader, 6 general cargo loaders, 1 fertiliser discharger, 1 general cargo discharger. 21 Waiting in roads, 11 to load (3 sugar, 6 pellets, 2 general cargo). 10 To discharge (7 fertiliser, 1 reefer, 1 containers, 1 general cargo) 7 due over next 7 days.

Rio de Janeiro - 13 Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 2 wheat dischargers, 1 bulk discharger, 1 container discharger, 1 steel products discharger, 2 container/general cargo dischargers, 3 steel products loaders, 2 sugar. Tecon - 4 Vessels, 25 due over next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar commercial quay - No vessels, 1 in roads, 9 due over next 7 days.

CHILE, Nov 18 - Arica - Two vessels in port operating, 3 berths vacant, 7 due during week. Iquique - One vessel in port operating, 4 berths vacant, 6 due in week. Antofagasta - Five berthed, 1 berth vacant, 6 due in week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. No vessels in roads. Valparaiso - Two berthed/operating, 6 berths vacant, 1 berth (pier 3) out of service, 16 due in week. San Antonio - Four in port operating, 1 berth vacant, 14 due. Port busy but no waiting time. Puerto Montt - One vessel berthed at terminal, none in roads, 2 due in week. Punta Arenas - One vessel, 1 coaster berthed, 7 vessels and coasters due in week, no vessels in roads. Conception Bay - Talcahuano - No vessels berthed, 2 due, none in roads. San Vicente - Three berthed and operating, no berths vacant, none in roads, 3 due in week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels at terminal, 2 due in week. Steel pier - No vessels. Coronel pier - 1 At terminal, 1 due. Oil terminal - 1 At terminal, none due in week. Lirquen - Two operating, 4 berths vacant, 1 in roads, 1 due. Penco - No vessels berthed.

PERU, Nov 18 - No strikes at any port. Callao - No vessels anchored, 10 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored. 1 Fishmeal vessel berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Ilo - No vessels, no delays. Talara - Three vessels anchored, 2 tankers berthed, no delays. Chimbote - One fish meal vessel anchored, no vessels berthed, no delays. Pisco - No vessels anchored, 3 briquette vessels berthed, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Nov 19 - Orinoco River - Draft 33 ft. 6 in. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels operating of which 1 discharging manganese, 1 loading iron ore, 4 vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel loading iron ore, 1 vessel due. Palua - Two vessels due. Mile 178 - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load. Matanzas - One vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge. 5 Vessels operating of which 3 loading steel products, 1 discharging coke, 1 discharging scrap. 1 Vessel due. Interalumina - One vessel loading alumina. Venalum - Two vessels due. San felix - Two vessels due. Punta cuchillo - Two vessels due. Puerto Cabello - 17 Vessels operating of which 13 loading/discharging generals, 4 discharging grain, 9 vessels due. Guanta - Two vessels operating of which 1 discharging pipes, 1 loading aluminium, 3 vessels due. La Guaira - No information received. Maracaibo - One vessel due. Bajo Grande - 10 vessels loading refined products. El Tablazo - One vessel due. La Ceiba - One vessel due. Cardon - Five vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products. Amuay - Three vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products. All ports working normally.
